## Purpose

`generated-variable-crosswalk.csv` is the audit table for all generated columns
currently listed in `generated-schema-register.csv`. It does not assert that a
candidate is correct unless the status says the row is directly matched or has
a manual same-dataset crosswalk. It records the evidence status for each
generated column so unresolved implementation fields stay visible.

## Files

| File | Rows | Meaning |
|---|---:|---|
| [`generated-schema-register.csv`](generated-schema-register.csv) | 1585 | Observed generated schema, types, missingness, and sampled domains/distributions. |
| [`generated-variable-crosswalk.csv`](generated-variable-crosswalk.csv) | 1585 | Crosswalk/evidence status for every generated variable. |
| [`local-metadata-variable-inventory.csv`](local-metadata-variable-inventory.csv) | 49987 | Full local PLIDA/BLADE metadata inventory for the dataset families covered by the guides. |

## Crosswalk Status Counts

| Status | Rows | Interpretation |
|---|---:|---|
| `direct_blade_variable_metadata` | 825 | Generated BLADE variable matched local `inst/blade_metadata/variables.csv`. |
| `direct_plida_dataset_variable` | 692 | Generated variable matched local PLIDA metadata by `dataset + variable`. |
| `manual_same_dataset_plida_concept_match` | 58 | Manual same-dataset concept crosswalk from compact/generated name to a local PLIDA metadata variable. |
| `generated_compact_from_same_dataset_metadata` | 4 | Generated field compacts multiple same-dataset source-style metadata columns into one generated column. |
| `generated_derived_from_same_dataset_metadata` | 2 | Generated field is derived from a same-dataset metadata variable, usually a date component. |
| `external_source_concept_not_source_equivalent` | 3 | An official/public source concept exists, but the generated field is a local simplification and is not source-equivalent. |
| `local_generator_not_source_equivalent` | 1 | A related same-dataset metadata variable exists, but the generated field is deliberately not source-equivalent. |

| Guide | Dataset | Variable | Status | Candidate | Note |

| dhda-health | `NACDC` | `INDIGENOUS_STATUS` | `external_source_concept_not_source_equivalent` | `NACDC/indigenous_status_code` | Public NACDC May 2026 table-specification concepts exist, but generated `Y`/`N` is a local binary collapse and is not source-equivalent to the multi-category NACDC codes. |
| pit | `PIT_PS` | `SUPER_GUARANTEE` | `local_generator_not_source_equivalent` | `PIT_PS/RPRTBL_EMPLYR_SUPER_CNTRBN_AMT` | Do not treat generated SUPER_GUARANTEE as an official PIT_PS source variable; it is local synthetic SG logic. |
| pit | `PIT_PS` | `UNION_FEES` | `external_source_concept_not_source_equivalent` | `ATO/union and professional association fees` | ATO deduction concept exists, but no same-dataset PIT_PS local metadata candidate was found; generated field remains implementation-only. |
| pit | `PIT_PS` | `WORKPLACE_GIVING` | `external_source_concept_not_source_equivalent` | `ATO/STP/IDV_WRKPLC_GVING_TOTL_AMT` | ATO workplace-giving and local STP metadata concepts exist, but no same-dataset PIT_PS local metadata candidate was found; generated field remains implementation-only. |

## Use Rule

Rows with `direct_*` status can be treated as local metadata-backed generated
fields. Rows with `manual_same_dataset_plida_concept_match` are local
crosswalks from generated names to same-dataset PLIDA metadata variables, but
they still should not be presented as official source variable names. Rows with
`generated_compact_from_same_dataset_metadata` or
`generated_derived_from_same_dataset_metadata` are implementation fields backed
by local metadata concepts, not literal source columns. Rows with `unresolved_*`,
`external_source_concept_not_source_equivalent`, or
`local_generator_not_source_equivalent` must remain labelled as
implementation-only or not-source-equivalent until stronger evidence is found.
